fact: More than 75,000 food-voucher beneficiaries completed digital purchases at local stores with SmartSwitch Botswana's biometrics-enabled smart card, described as government social-benefit payments.
source_slug: 2025-05-29 Biometric payment card system pushing financial inclusion in Botswana

fact: Food voucher beneficiaries under a Ministry of Local Government programme receive a monthly allowance on a SmartSwitch biometric smart card, used at over 1,200 shops; more than 75,000 beneficiaries are covered, replacing a paper-based food basket system.
